mainEntity.name: How long does ISO 27001 certification take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A scoped ISO 27001 implementation typically takes 2–4 months for mid-sized organisations. Larger enterprises with complex environments may require 4–6 months depending on the number of controls that need remediation, team availability and existing documentation maturity.

mainEntity.name: What is the cost of ISO 27001 certification in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISO 27001 certification cost in India varies based on organisational size, scope, number of employees and existing controls. ISECURION offers competitive packages for startups, mid-market and enterprise clients. Contact us for a tailored quote.

mainEntity.name: Do we need a certification body to get ISO 27001 certified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISO 27001 certification is issued by an accredited third-party certification body (CB) such as BSI, Bureau Veritas, TÜV, DNV or NQA. ISECURION prepares your ISMS artifacts and coordinates Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits on your behalf.

mainEntity.name: What version of ISO 27001 should we certify on?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is the current standard. All new certifications must be issued against the 2022 edition. Organisations certified under ISO 27001:2013 must transition by October 2025. ISECURION handles transition projects for 2013-certified organisations.

ISO 27001 is not universally mandatory in India but is strongly recommended or contractually required in many sectors. RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and DPDP-regulated entities benefit significantly from ISO 27001 as it demonstrates a mature information security posture and is frequently demanded by enterprise customers.

mainEntity.name: Does ISECURION provide ISO 27001 consulting outside India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ISECURION provides remote and on-site ISO 27001 consulting services across USA, UK, UAE, GCC (Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), Singapore, Australia, Germany, Netherlands and France.

mainEntity.name: What industries does ISECURION serve for ISO 27001?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION has completed ISO 27001 projects for SaaS, FinTech, HealthTech, EdTech, cloud services, data centres, IT services, e-commerce, logistics, BFSI, insurance and manufacturing companies.

mainEntity.name: What is an ISMS gap analysis?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ISMS gap analysis evaluates your current information security controls against ISO 27001:2022 requirements and Annex A controls. The output is a prioritised remediation plan, maturity score and estimated effort to achieve certification readiness.

mainEntity.name: How many Annex A controls are in ISO 27001:2022?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISO 27001:2022 includes 93 Annex A controls across 4 themes: Organisational (37), People (8), Physical (14) and Technological (34). This is a reduction from the 114 controls in the 2013 edition, with 11 new controls added.

name: How to Get ISO 27001 Certified with ISECURION
description: A 5-phase process to achieve ISO 27001 certification for your organisation.

step.name: Scoping & Consultation
step.text: Define your ISMS scope, assets, systems, vendors and key stakeholders.

step.name: Gap Assessment & Risk Treatment
step.text: Assess existing controls against ISO 27001:2022, run risk assessments and propose risk treatment options.

step.name: ISMS Documentation & Control Design
step.text: Create policies, SoA, risk register, incident playbooks and all required ISMS documentation.

step.name: Implementation & Internal Audit
step.text: Deploy technical and organisational controls, train teams and conduct a formal internal audit.

step.name: Certification & Continuous Monitoring
step.text: Coordinate Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits with the accredited CB and establish ongoing ISMS health checks.
